limitations: Exact manufacturer case only. No complete PCB/Gerber or populated component CAD published in the audited product directory; internal board is visibly UNKNOWN.

Film, LED optical apertures, connectors and visible fastener heads have separately documented photo/drawing estimates. Hidden component dimensions/assembly, translucent shell photometry and LED diffusion are not calibrated.
The16×16 emitter mapping is row-major front-view geometry. Actual firmware-driver orientation must be checked in runtime tests; illumination is never taken from source photography.

Rear print uses original paper-only alpha mask; independently observed connector openings and native engravings stay geometric. Original photo lighting and submillimetre label placement remain uncertain.
No physical unit measurements or whole-product100% reproduction claim. Source-rebuild/geometry checks do not establish firmware compatibility.

visualAssessment.unknownReadable: Public inspection separation exposes rear UNKNOWN label while complete assembly remains visible.
visualAssessment.appearance: Gold and transparent purple preserve original LED, connector, key and printed-sheet materials.
knownDeviations: Renderer material response and LED optical bloom differ from photographed lighting; no calibrated photometric match.
Internal PCB/components have no manufacturing CAD; blank UNKNOWN board and approximate visible connector envelopes remain.
Rear sheet thickness/depth, screw hidden geometry, connector internal depth and pin lengths are unmeasured.
Orthographic side photographs contain small perspective, shadow and lens effects; silhouette results do not prove every visible detail.

curation.note: Measurements and original verifier hash retained; current verifier keeps raw captures outside Git and limits comparison-preview size.
